ITEM 1 | Shredded orange strands, bright orange with slightly glossy, fine matchstick-like threads about 0.2 cm thick and 4-6 cm long, moist, tangled loosely in a pile at the lower-left of the bowl | 45
ITEM 2 | Cubed pale off-white pieces with a matte, slightly dry surface, uniform cubes about 1.5-2 cm per side, some with faint tan edges, firm and holding shape, piled densely across the upper and right portion of the bowl | 190
ITEM 3 | Thin pale purple-white onion-like slivers, translucent edges, crescent-shaped strips about 0.2 cm wide and 3-5 cm long, moist, scattered beneath and between the carrot and cubes at the bottom of the bowl | 25
ITEM 4 | Small bright green pieces, thin strips about 3-4 cm long with pale stem ends, slightly glossy, mostly hidden under the cubes at the upper right edge of the bowl | 5
